headline: Tongi drug gang held DT journalists hostage and tortured them at gunpoint
summary: The attack on Dhaka Tribune journalists highlights the growing power of drug syndicates in Tongi, which continue to operate despite repeated law enforcement crackdowns.
details: Dhaka Tribune journalists were held hostage and tortured at gunpoint by a drug gang operating in Tongi.
The incident underscores the dangerous environment for reporters covering crime and narcotics trade in the region.
Tongi has become a hub for drug empires that reportedly defy repeated crackdowns by law enforcement agencies.
The attack serves as a warning to the media and highlights the security risks faced by journalists reporting on organized crime in Bangladesh.
caption:
Journalists held hostage and tortured at gunpoint. A chilling reminder of the danger of reporting on drug empires.

Dhaka Tribune journalists were held hostage and tortured at gunpoint by a drug gang operating in Tongi.

The incident underscores the dangerous environment for reporters covering crime and narcotics trade in the region.

Tongi has become a hub for drug empires that reportedly defy repeated crackdowns by law enforcement agencies.

The attack serves as a warning to the media and highlights the security risks faced by journalists reporting on organized crime in Bangladesh.

Source: Dhaka Tribune

headline_marked: School bus torched, [[crude bombs explode across Dhaka]] to spread panic
headline: School bus torched, crude bombs explode across Dhaka to spread panic
summary: Attacks hit the CID headquarters, Pallabi Police Station, and Dhaka University, while a school bus was set on fire in Vatara.
details: Miscreants set fire to a school bus belonging to Jolsiri Cantonment School and College in the Vatara area of the capital. The bus was parked on the roadside when it was torched, with videos of the blaze circulating online.
caption:
A school bus torched, multiple crude bomb blasts hit the capital.

Miscreants set fire to a school bus belonging to Jolsiri Cantonment School and College in the Vatara area of the capital. The bus was parked on the roadside when it was torched, with videos of the blaze circulating online.

#Dhaka #Bangladesh #BreakingNews #SecurityAlert

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star, bdnews24.com, Prothom Alo
